_design_fix_vs_001A: 001A's grok_negative required 'ALL runs train>=0.95 & heldout<=0.60' -> wd=1.0 couldn't fit -> unsatisfiable -> spec-artifact 'ambiguous'. 001B conditions the verdict ONLY on cells that actually FIT (train>=0.95). A wd that never fits is marked uninformative, not blocking.
_honest_prior: Given 001A wd=0.1 fully fit then ran 34k more steps with heldout flat ~0.55-0.59 (no late rise), I expect 001B most likely confirms grok_negative. The fit+reg band is nonetheless the genuine untested spot, so this is a legitimate last check. In-context per-episode rule inference is not classic grokking; do not over-read.
_purpose: LAST cheap learnability probe. The fit+regularization 'Goldilocks' band is the only untested spot: 001A had wd=0.1 (fit, NO grokking) and wd=1.0 (over-regularized, did NOT fit). Test wd in {0.3,0.5} (fit AND regularized) for the SAME frozen transformer 256/4 on rung0. Resolves the route either way (escalate or close); no more single-config probes after this.
_underpowered_by_design: 3 seeds x 2 wd = 6 runs; route_decision.py returns inconclusive_underpowered BY DESIGN; signal = fitted-cell val-curve shape + trend.
